```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(raster)

t_crs<-"+proj=aea +lat_1=-9 +lat_2=-26 +lat_0=-17 +lon_0=180 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"
```

# Read in data

## Connected 

```{r}
connected<-st_read(here("output_data/Rivers/Fiji_connected_pourpoints.shp"))
st_crs(connected)<-t_crs
```

## Septic

```{r}
septic<-st_read(here("output_data/Rivers/Fiji_septic_pourpoints.shp")) %>% 
  rename(N_septic = N,
         P_septic = P,
         N_septic_leach = N_leach,
         P_septic_leach = P_leach)
st_crs(septic)<-t_crs
```


## Direct

```{r}
direct<-st_read(here("output_data/Rivers/Fiji_direct_pourpoints.shp")) %>% 
  rename(N_direct = N,
         P_direct = P,
         N_direct_leach = N_leach,
         P_direct_leach = P_leach)
st_crs(direct)<-t_crs
```

## Tourism 

```{r}

```

# Combine

```{r}
unconnected<-st_join(direct,septic) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-HYRIV_ID.y, -MAIN_BAS.y) %>% 
  rename(HYRIV_ID = HYRIV_ID.x,
         MAIN_BAS = MAIN_BAS.x) %>% 
  mutate(un_N = N_septic + N_direct,
         un_P = P_septic + P_direct,
         un_N_leach = N_septic_leach + N_direct_leach,
         un_P_leach = P_septic_leach + P_direct_leach)

unconnected_final<-unconnected %>% 
  dplyr::select(HYRIV_ID, un_N_leach, un_P_leach, N_septic_leach, N_direct_leach, P_septic_leach, P_direct_leach) %>% 
  rename(pourpoint =HYRIV_ID) %>% 
  mutate(conn_N = NA,
         conn_P = NA)
```

```{r}
connected_final<-connected %>% 
  dplyr::select(Name, N, P) %>% 
  rename(pourpoint = Name,
         conn_N = N,
         conn_P = P) %>% 
mutate(un_N_leach = NA,
         un_P_leach = NA,
         N_septic_leach = NA,
         N_direct_leach = NA,
         P_septic_leach = NA,
         P_direct_leach = NA)

```

```{r}
test<-rbind(connected_final, unconnected_final)
```
